csrf_mechanism.xsrf_cookie: XSRF-TOKEN (read from cookie, URL-decoded, sent as x-xsrf-token header)
csrf_mechanism.meta_token: scraped from <meta name="csrf-token" content="..."> in homepage HTML, sent as _token body field

captcha.note: Captcha response is included in POST body, but the site seems to use it loosely - may work without it via curl_cffi impersonation

notes: IDENTICAL to tempmailq.com Laravel pattern. Same dual-CSRF mechanism. Can reuse cli_tmq.py/_tmq_get_session logic. Domain: tomail.fyi. Has recaptcha but curl_cffi impersonation should bypass fingerprinting.
